name: atuin
description: `atuin update` (opt-in) delegates to axoupdater — downloads+executes an installer script, no checksum/sig (same as uv).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: In the reviewed atuin snapshot, the update command uses AxoUpdater, requires a matching standalone-installer receipt, and runs only through the optional self-update feature used by official installer artifacts. Verification performed inside axoupdater remains unresolved.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; axoupdater implementation and release artifact verification were not inspected.

original_evidence.text: | atuin | atuinsh/atuin @ a3cc4015 (2026-08-19) | Y (opt-in, manual) | N (manual `atuin update` command; separate passive "update available" notice can be opportunistically on) | Y | HTTPS | N | N | N/A (no verification performed) | Cargo feature gate: `crates/atuin/Cargo.toml:61-67` ("`atuin update`: self-update via the cargo-dist install receipt... only the official installer artifacts can self-update"; `self-update = ["dep:axoupdater"]`). Command impl: `crates/atuin/src/command/client/update.rs:1-99` — only enabled if an install-receipt from the standalone `setup.atuin.sh` installer is present (line 28-33), user must explicitly run `atuin update`/`atuin update --check` (no autorun). Actual download+exec happens in the `axoupdater` crate it depends on (see next row) — atuin itself does not verify the installer it invokes. Separate, independently-gated **passive check-only** path: Cargo feature `check-update` (`crates/atuin-client/Cargo.toml:21`) hits `GET https://api.atuin.sh` (`crates/atuin-client/src/settings.rs:41-42`, `DEFAULT_SYNC_URL`) via `crates/atuin-client/src/api_client.rs:165-176` (`latest_version()`), throttled to once/hour (`crates/atuin-client/src/settings.rs:1331-1336`), and only *prints* a notice via `needs_update()` (`settings.rs:1371-1394`) — never downloads/executes a payload. |
